# codec plugin

/*
Codec Plugin 可以支持在 Codec 中自定义编码解码，自定义 Bypass 与字符串处理函数

函数定义非常简单

func(i: string) string
*/

handle = func(origin /*string*/) {

    origin = codec.StrconvQuote(origin)
    data = str.f(`{"language":"php","files":[{"name":"main.php","content":%v}]}`, origin)

    rsp, err = http.Post("https://www.lddgo.net/api/RunCode", http.header("Accept", "application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01"), http.header("Content-Type", "application/json;charset=UTF-8"), http.header(`User-Agent`, `Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/104.0.0.0 Safari/537.36`), http.body(data))
    rspraw, rawerr = http.dump(rsp)
    header, body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rspraw)
    report = json.loads(body)

    return report["data"]["stdout"]
    
}
